dialogue.en: May I join you?
Of course. Are you here on vacation?
Yes, from Shanghai. The coffee is good.
It's the local roast. What city are you from?
dialogue.zh: 是本地烘焙。你从哪个城市来？

dialogue.en: Shanghai. Have you been?
Not yet. I'd like to visit someday.

phrases.en: What are you planning to see today?

dialogue.en: Is this your first time at this hotel?
dialogue.zh: 你第一次住这家酒店吗？

dialogue.en: Second time. I come for work every spring.
dialogue.zh: 第二次。我每年春天来出差。

dialogue.en: Nice. What are you planning to see today?
dialogue.zh: 不错。你今天打算看什么？

dialogue.en: The art museum. Do you know if the breakfast ends at ten?
dialogue.zh: 艺术博物馆。你知道早餐十点结束吗？

dialogue.en: I think so. The weather is perfect today.
It is. Perfect for walking.
Enjoy the rest of your trip.
dialogue.zh: 祝你接下来的旅途愉快。

dialogue.en: You too. Maybe I'll see you tomorrow.

phrases.en: I'm still adjusting to the time difference. You?
It was nice chatting. I should head to my meeting.

dialogue.en: I noticed you're reading that book. Is it any good?
dialogue.zh: 我看你在看那本书。好看吗？

dialogue.en: It's excellent. I'm almost finished.
I'll add it to my list. I'm here for a conference. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 我加到书单。我来开会。你呢？

dialogue.en: Visiting family. Any hidden gems in this neighborhood you'd recommend?
dialogue.zh: 探亲。这个街区有什么隐藏好去处推荐吗？

dialogue.en: The noodle shop on the corner is great.
I'll try it. I'm still adjusting to the time difference. You?
dialogue.zh: 我去试试。我还在倒时差。你呢？

dialogue.en: Same. The coffee helps.
It was nice chatting. I should head to my meeting.
dialogue.zh: 聊得很开心。我该去开会了。

dialogue.en: Me too. Have a good day.

What time do we leave?
Where is the meeting point?
Can I take a photo?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, is this the tour group?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，这是旅行团吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. Are you Mr. Zhang?
That's me. What time do we leave?
In ten minutes. Please stay by the fountain.
dialogue.zh: 十分钟后。请待在喷泉旁边。

dialogue.en: Got it. Where is the meeting point?
Right here by the fountain.
Thanks. Can I take a photo?
Sure, we have five minutes.

phrases.en: How many people are in the group?
Will we have free time at the museum?
phrases.zh: 博物馆有自由活动时间吗？

phrases.en: Is lunch included?
What should I bring?
Can I get the guide's phone number?

dialogue.en: How many people are in the group?
Twelve people.
Will we have free time at the museum?
dialogue.zh: 博物馆有自由活动时间吗？

dialogue.en: Forty minutes after the tour.
Good. Is lunch included?
Lunch is on your own.
Okay. What should I bring?
Comfortable shoes and water.
Thanks. Can I get the guide's phone number?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能给我导游电话吗？

dialogue.en: It's on the itinerary.

phrases.en: I'm traveling with my elderly parents. Is the walking pace manageable?
phrases.zh: 我和年迈的父母一起。步行强度可以吗？

phrases.en: The itinerary says two hours, but the guide is running late. Will we still see everything?
phrases.zh: 行程写两小时，但导游晚了。还能看完吗？

phrases.en: Can we skip the shopping stop? We'd rather spend more time at the temple.
phrases.zh: 能跳过购物点吗？我们更想在寺庙多待。

phrases.en: My child has a food allergy. Can the lunch stop accommodate that?
phrases.zh: 我孩子食物过敏。午餐点能照顾吗？

phrases.en: If I get separated from the group, what's the emergency contact?
phrases.zh: 如果我走散，紧急联系人是谁？

dialogue.en: I'm traveling with my elderly parents. Is the walking pace manageable?
dialogue.zh: 我和年迈的父母一起。步行强度可以吗？

dialogue.en: We can slow down and take breaks.
dialogue.zh: 我们可以慢一点，多休息。

dialogue.en: Thank you. The itinerary says two hours, but the guide is running late. Will we still see everything?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。行程写两小时，但导游晚了。还能看完吗？

dialogue.en: We'll shorten the shopping stop to make up time.
dialogue.zh: 我们缩短购物点来补时间。

dialogue.en: Good. Can we skip the shopping stop? We'd rather spend more time at the temple.
dialogue.zh: 好。能跳过购物点吗？我们更想在寺庙多待。

dialogue.en: I'll ask the group.
Thanks. My child has a food allergy. Can the lunch stop accommodate that?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我孩子食物过敏。午餐点能照顾吗？

dialogue.en: I'll call ahead and ask.
Great. If I get separated from the group, what's the emergency contact?
dialogue.zh: 好。如果我走散，紧急联系人是谁？

dialogue.en: My number is on the back of your badge.
dialogue.zh: 我的号码在你胸牌背面。

The elevator is slow.
Have a good night.

dialogue.en: Hi, I'm in room 806.
Nice to meet you. Are you staying long?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。你住很久吗？

dialogue.en: Three nights. The elevator is slow.
It is. I usually take the stairs.
Good idea. Have a good night.
You too.

phrases.en: Is the laundry room on this floor?
Do you know a good place for breakfast nearby?
phrases.zh: 你知道附近哪里吃早餐好吗？

phrases.en: The hallway is quiet at night.
Are you in town for work?
Let me know if you need anything.

dialogue.en: Is the laundry room on this floor?
It's in the basement.
Thanks. Do you know a good place for breakfast nearby?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。你知道附近哪里吃早餐好吗？

dialogue.en: The diner on the corner opens at seven.
dialogue.zh: 转角那家餐厅七点开门。

dialogue.en: Good. The hallway is quiet at night.
It usually is.
Are you in town for work?
Yes, a conference.
Let me know if you need anything.
Thanks, you too.

phrases.en: The music from your room is keeping me awake. Could you turn it down?
phrases.zh: 你房间的音乐让我睡不着。能调小吗？

phrases.en: I noticed water leaking from under your door. Do you need help?
phrases.zh: 我看到你门下有水漏出来。需要帮忙吗？

phrases.en: The building's fire alarm went off twice last night. Do you know why?
phrases.zh: 大楼火警昨晚响了两次。你知道为什么吗？

phrases.en: I'm locked out and the front desk isn't answering. Can I use your phone?
phrases.zh: 我被锁在外面，前台没人接。能用你的电话吗？

phrases.en: I'm checking out tomorrow. Thanks for being a quiet neighbor.
phrases.zh: 我明天退房。谢谢你这个安静的邻居。

dialogue.en: The music from your room is keeping me awake. Could you turn it down?
dialogue.zh: 你房间的音乐让我睡不着。能调小吗？

dialogue.en: Sorry, I didn't realize. I'll use headphones.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我没意识到。我用耳机。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I noticed water leaking from under your door. Do you need help?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我看到你门下有水漏出来。需要帮忙吗？

dialogue.en: The washing machine overflowed. I'm calling maintenance.
dialogue.zh: 洗衣机溢水了。我在叫维修。

dialogue.en: The building's fire alarm went off twice last night. Do you know why?
dialogue.zh: 大楼火警昨晚响了两次。你知道为什么吗？

dialogue.en: Someone burned toast in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 有人在厨房烤焦了面包。

dialogue.en: I see. I'm locked out and the front desk isn't answering. Can I use your phone?
dialogue.zh: 明白。我被锁在外面，前台没人接。能用你的电话吗？

dialogue.en: Of course you can.
Thank you. I'm checking out tomorrow. Thanks for being a quiet neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我明天退房。谢谢你这个安静的邻居。

dialogue.en: You too. Safe travels.
